description:
Implement the full kiosk/TV mode UX. This scenario is designed to be loaded on a TV (e.g., via Xbox browser) and left running as an always-on display.

**Fullscreen mode:**
- Proper Fullscreen API integration with enter/exit controls
- Auto-prompt to enter fullscreen on first load (or remember preference)

**Auto-cycle:**
- Configurable timer (e.g., 30s, 60s, 2min, 5min) that rotates through dashboard pages
- Smooth animated transitions between pages (cross-fade respecting theme boundaries)
- Progress indicator showing time until next page (subtle, theme-aware)
- Pause auto-cycle on user interaction, resume after inactivity timeout
- Skip option: user can mark certain dashboards to exclude from cycle
- Cycle order: configurable or default to natural page order

**Hidden controls:**
- All navigation, settings, and UI chrome hidden by default
- Appear on mouse movement, touch, or remote control input
- Auto-hide after 3-5 seconds of inactivity
- Settings accessible via a subtle gear icon that appears on interaction

**Settings panel:**
- Slide-out or overlay panel for: dashboard selection (toggle which are in cycle), cycle timing adjustment, fullscreen toggle, per-dashboard configuration

**Remote-friendly:**
- Must work with TV remote / Xbox controller navigation
- Large touch targets (minimum 48px, prefer 64px)
- D-pad navigation support between dashboards, A/Enter selects

**Wake lock:** Use Screen Wake Lock API to prevent display sleep in kiosk mode.

**Error resilience:** If an upstream data source is unavailable, show last cached data with subtle "stale" indicator. Never show error modals or crash screens on a TV.

**URL params:** Support ?dashboard=panorama&fullscreen=true&cycle=60s for bookmarkable configurations.
name: command-center-kiosk-ux
title: Implement kiosk mode, auto-cycle, and TV-optimized UX
